_meta.note: Completes the OpenAI legacy system-card sweep by mining every table S261 deferred. GPT-5 system card Tables 2/4/6/7/9/11/12/13; o3-o4-mini Tables 1/2/5/6/7/8/9/10/11/12; gpt-oss Tables 2/4/8. All read from the local pdftotext extractions of the PDFs already archived in resource/. The Standard disallowed-content tables are included after all (S261 had skipped them on the grounds that OpenAI calls them saturated) because the user asked for full coverage and the values are explicit — they are registered under their own std_refusal_* ids, separate from the harder Production Benchmarks, so the two suites are never mixed. gpt-oss Table 2's per-language MMMLU (14 languages x 6 model/effort columns + 3 OpenAI baselines) shares the mmlu_lang_* ids with GPT-5 Table 11's MMLU Language rows, since both are the same translated-MMLU suite. Comparator columns for o1 / o3-mini / o4-mini-high / o3-high are included because those models already exist in the DB. Two intra-batch collisions were resolved by preferring each model's own card: o3 phrase-protection comes from the o3 card rather than the GPT-5 restatement (which differs slightly), and the gpt-oss o3-high MMMLU column was dropped as identical to GPT-5 Table 11. vision_refusal_* is kept separate from the existing vision_safety_* ids because the o3 card splits self-harm into intent/instructions while vision_safety_* uses a single self-harm category. STILL NOT INGESTED (no extractable model-attributable numbers): gpt-oss Tables 1 (parameter counts, not a benchmark), 11/12/13 and GPT-5 Table 14 and o3 Tables 13/14 — these are eval-overview tables whose cells are prose descriptions, with the actual Preparedness bio/cyber results presented in figures; GPT-5 Table 4's online-prevalence row (-0.69/-0.75 relative deltas, not a standalone score); and gpt-oss Table 3's high-effort column plus the Codeforces/HealthBench rows already loaded in S261.
